title: Fort Worth pit, vaudeville circuit, and a week with the Dixieland Jazz Band
summary: Brewster goes into vaudeville from a Fort Worth theater, meets his old friend again in Houston, then tells of subbing with the Dixieland Jazz Band, Russell Robinson, his daughter Marcia, and trombonists Miff Mole and Jack Teagarden.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
